verdict.rationale: Mastra is self-hosted and Apache 2.0 licensed for core self-host use (mastra-docs-11), implying users control their own storage/data rather than being locked into a vendor-hosted silo, but there is no explicit documentation of a data-export feature or open-format export tooling. Community evidence also disputes the framework's 'open source' framing, noting the Elastic v2 license restricts hosting the software as a service (mastra-comm-2), which undercuts the openness narrative. Missing for 10: explicit data export/portability documentation, confirmation of a single consistent open license across all components, and independent verification that self-hosted data is freely portable.
